we need to understand that the combustion process in boilers is not only a function of fuel and air but also a function of the boiler design, the burner design and the combustion air distribution system.

the use of a coal burner with a low volatile matter content and a low ash content can reduce the carbon in the fly ash, and the use of an oil burner can reduce the carbon content in the fly ash to a greater extent, which is conducive to improving the quality of fly ash.
